description: This file contains a single exported function 'shapeAgentGroupedSeries' that processes an array of cost record objects into a grouped dataset suitable for visualization with Recharts, ensuring consistent categories across agents and handling missing data. It includes detailed documentation and parameters for customization.

methods.name: shapeAgentGroupedSeries(records, groupBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms raw cost records into a grouped dataset with optional sorting and category labeling, supporting visualization needs.
